name: @logquill/wasm
description: LogQuill for the browser, Deno, Bun and Workers: the Rust core (wasm32-unknown-unknown) and a small SDK on top of it.

scripts.test:node: node scripts/run-corpus.mjs && node --test tests/wasm.test.mjs tests/no-node-builtins.test.mjs tests/sdk.test.mjs
scripts.test:deno: npm run build:hosts && deno run --allow-read tests/hosts/deno.mjs
scripts.test:hosts: npm run test:deno && npm run test:bun && npm run test:chrome && npm run test:worker
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:sdk && npm run test:node && npm run test:hosts && npm run test:examples && npm run pack-smoke && npm run check:budget
scripts.test:bun: npm run build:hosts && bun run tests/hosts/bun.mjs
